Looked up for Sarah: At 10 cents, a 650-watt miner runs about $47 a month in power; a 400-watt one about $29.

Hey, I'm Sarah! I know every miner we carry, and I'm here to help. Under twelve cents, that's a good rate for mining. Give me a second and I'll run the Harlo H15 Dual — Bitcoin + Dogecoin at that price. Roughly what do you pay, ten, eleven? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
At ten cents you're in good shape. The H15 Dual is nine ninety-nine, ships November 14, and mines Bitcoin and Dogecoin at the same time. Is this your first miner?
Read the bsb b30 dual page
Looked up for Sarah: H15 Dual can't be ordered yet — the drop date isn't announced, so don't promise Nov 14. The B30, $899, 30 TH/s, is orderable now.
Nice, then it's about the extra hashrate. The H15 sells as a drop, and the date isn't out yet. The Harlo B30 is eight ninety-nine for thirty terahash, and you can buy it today. Which one do you want?
Looked up for Sarah: 100 units are loaded for the H15 drop; we can't hold one, it's first to check out — offer the Notify me list on the page.

Fair enough. One correction: the drop date isn't announced yet, so I can't promise November 14. Drops sell first come, first served, so watch this page. Want to look at the B30 meanwhile? (The call ended. 3 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
